sac.note: joint behind the head: breathes (scale ~1.0-1.05) and sways a few degrees

feelers.note: both horns hinge at the crest: wiggle +-8 degrees, opposite phases

armL.note: left shoulder: swings +-25 degrees as she walks

armR.note: right shoulder: swings +-25 degrees, opposite phase

head.note: centre of the head: bobs 2-3 units, turns +-6 degrees
